papers.title: What Does the Refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis Mean for Learning Theory?
papers.learning: Locality, description length, accuracy and coefficient representation govern the transfer from counting to learning and exact inference. Fixed-width SETH and unbounded-width CNF-SETH are different hypotheses.
assumptions: Bound the bits read by each local factor
Include precision and sample/formula length
Do not infer a bound for arbitrary dense models
papers.reported_evidence: Imported ETH counting theorems and written reductions; no local formal verification

papers.title: The Euclidean algorithm is not optimal among uniform processes
papers.learning: Reusable Euclidean prefixes reduce remainder-only derivation length. Uniform-process existence does not by itself supply a faster finite-program gcd implementation.
assumptions: The cost counts remainder calls, not selection or bit complexity
The Main Conjecture for algorithms remains open
papers.reported_evidence: Main remainder-call bounds reported formalized; best-uniform-process theorem imported

papers.title: Deterministic Factoring in Time $N^{o(1)}$
papers.learning: Count nontrivial divisors by binary prefix, choose the least feasible prefix, and repeat smallest-factor extraction for complete factorization.
assumptions: One fixed machine in the asymptotic statement
The local counter is OpenAI-based, not the paper's Anthropic engine
The stronger sqrt-log-log rate is a conjecture
papers.reported_evidence: Theorem 1 reported Lean-checked; Theorem 2 is a written corollary; source proof not rebuilt locally

papers.title: Subexponential Weighted Counting and Exact Optimisation
papers.learning: Use generating-polynomial coefficients to recover cost distributions and optima from local weighted counting, rather than replacing ring operations by min-plus operations.
assumptions: Commutative Q-algebra for the source interpolation
Fixed locality and linear factor density in Theorem 5.3
Charge coefficient precision and degree; handle truncation explicitly
papers.reported_evidence: Written proof and source reproduction; local implementation is exhaustive and asserts no source runtime

papers.title: On counting satisfying assignments via polynomial separation
papers.learning: Separate the counting recovery interface from the construction supplying polynomial separation. Reconstruct exactly from Taylor data and Hermite interpolation.
assumptions: Account for construction, query and interpolation costs
Qualitative epsilon-dependent constants are not concrete benchmark parameters
papers.reported_evidence: Expository qualitative proof; independent implementation audit remains open

papers.title: Some exposition of “The Exponential Time Hypothesis Is False”
papers.learning: A low-rank correction to commuting SWAP operators explains the separation construction. The exposed cubic-graph independent-set counter is Las Vegas, with exact answers and randomized labeling.
assumptions: Quantum notation describes classical linear algebra
Randomized labeling and claimed derandomization are separate
Do not label an elimination-order limitation a general algorithm lower bound
papers.reported_evidence: Exposition; no local proof replay or new recursion implementation

papers.title: A $2^{o(n)}$ Time Algorithm for 3-SAT
papers.learning: Recursive algebraic network decompositions shrink the exponent for exact k-CNF counting. The variable, clause and width parameters and the universal-machine quantifiers must remain explicit.
assumptions: Source constants force astronomical crossover
Fixed-k ETH and fixed-k SETH consequences do not refute every fine-grained hypothesis
The Hexagon factoring note re-proves only part of this engine
papers.reported_evidence: Anthropic reports Lean and independent-kernel checks; not rerun in this session

papers.title: The rank of 3×3 matrix multiplication over F2 is 23
papers.learning: The reported exact bilinear rank of 3x3 matrix multiplication over F2 is 23; exhaustive completion produces independently checked certificates.
assumptions: Bilinear rank over F2 is not wall-time optimality
Do not transfer an F2 rank bound to arbitrary fields or nonlinear algorithms
Compiled-code and pure-kernel checks have different trust surfaces
papers.reported_evidence: Two Lean verification routes reported; neither rebuilt locally

papers.title: A degree-three local-weight cap and an improved relevant-variable bound
papers.learning: A degree-three local-degree potential cap improves a relevant-variable bound using exact rational certificates and an explicitly bounded infinite tail.
assumptions: Uses an imported ten-variable classification
Numerical certificate checking is not the full universal proof
Fourier/Boolean degree is not a Groebner solving degree
papers.reported_evidence: Two exact-arithmetic checkers reported; no proof-assistant verification claimed

papers.title: Polynomial Fault Detection Without Bounded Width: Exact Reachable Sets in Priority Controllers
papers.learning: Exact reachable images can make a specified fault-detection problem tractable despite large native width. Changing the fault type, optimization objective or counting task changes complexity.
assumptions: Only the specified bridge fault and guarded-decoder class
Do not transfer detection algorithms to minimum witnesses or counts
Retain full native CNF encoding and witness replay
papers.reported_evidence: Image statements reported formalized; broader algorithms and hardness are written arguments

papers.title: Unconstrained detection of productive autocatalytic cores is NP-complete
papers.learning: Literal reactant/product participation and signed-flow feasibility must be checked separately; cancellation in a net matrix does not preserve the original admissibility predicate.
assumptions: Binary literal-source encoding
Unconstrained structural possibility, not kinetics
Hardness needs the explicit model-preserving reduction
papers.reported_evidence: NP-completeness reported Lean-verified; no biochemical solver integration

papers.title: Deciding D-stability is coNP-hard
papers.learning: Universal positive-diagonal stability is different from testing a single scaling. The hardness reduction tracks integer magnitudes and polynomial binary output length.
assumptions: Weak hardness from binary PARTITION
coNP-hard is not coNP-complete
Numerical eigenvalue samples do not certify all diagonal scalings
papers.reported_evidence: Arithmetic and promise dichotomy reported formalized; total complexity argument partly conventional

papers.title: A Three-Polynomial Counterexample to the Generalized Effective Hypercube Nullstellensatz
papers.learning: Three low-degree Boolean generators can require unbounded reduced-product certificate degree even when their product is zero. Selector gadgets preserve hard faces.
assumptions: Real coefficients and Boolean-cube multilinearization
Does not contradict the two-generator theorem
Input degree alone does not bound certificate or solving degree
papers.reported_evidence: Unbounded theorem reported Lean-checked; local controls only check finite witness properties

papers.title: A Counterexample to Affine-Subspace Union Stability under Small Deletions
papers.learning: Deleting a 1/N fraction of each coordinate subspace can delete a central-binomial fraction of their union. Per-component retention is not global coverage retention.
assumptions: Highly overlapping affine coordinate subspaces
Local and global denominators must be distinguished
Finite witnesses do not independently prove the all-exponent asymptotic claim
papers.reported_evidence: Arbitrarily-large counterexample reported Lean-checked; finite overlap controls implemented locally

papers.title: An Approximate Solution to the Minimum Vertex Cover Problem: The Salvador Algorithm
papers.learning: An ensemble's per-instance certificate must be separated from its conjectured universal approximation guarantee. Keep every heuristic arm and exact lower-bound witness.
assumptions: The universal 3/2 ratio remains conjectural
The 2*tau-r bound has different scope
Test-suite success is not a universal approximation proof
papers.reported_evidence: Written bounds and empirical suite; stronger guarantee explicitly conjectured

papers.title: The Exact Junta Bound for Degree-Two Boolean Functions on q-ary Hamming Cubes
papers.learning: Boolean functions of Hamming degree at most two over a q-symbol alphabet have at most max(4,q+1) relevant coordinates; the larger-than-four case has selector structure.
assumptions: Hamming/junta degree, not ordinary univariate polynomial degree
Boolean output range
The selector conclusion does not make every four-junta two-query
papers.reported_evidence: Exact bound and selector structure reported formalized; no local proof replay

papers.title: Set Cover by Cyclic Rotations Is NP-Complete
papers.learning: Restricting set cover to rotations of one pattern does not guarantee tractability. The reduction's full indicator word and binary budget are part of the complexity claim.
assumptions: Explicitly listed pattern
All rotations and empty patterns included
Cyclic symmetry alone does not imply a fast exact coverage selector
papers.reported_evidence: Reduction, machine-level encoding and NP membership reported formalized

papers.title: A Polynomial Separation for Adaptive Fourier-Overlap Parity Decision Trees
papers.learning: Maximizing Fourier-support overlap can force polynomial-depth parity trees under every adaptive tie policy, even when unrestricted parity trees have logarithmic depth.
assumptions: Lower bound concerns this support-overlap query rule only
Characters must be nonconstant on the current affine domain
A singleton Fourier support need not mean a constant function
papers.reported_evidence: Adaptive separation reported Lean-checked; no general parity-tree lower bound claimed

papers.title: Subset Sum in time O(2^{0.4877n})
papers.learning: Phase-summed aliases and a pattern-selected checksum-filter family refine a randomized Subset Sum algorithm; checksums must not silently discard repeated representations.
assumptions: Polynomially bounded input bit lengths
Uniform randomized word-RAM algorithm with bounded error
Arb certificates verify numerical inequalities, not the entire algorithm
papers.reported_evidence: Written proof importing an earlier algorithm plus numerical certificates; fast Subset Sum engine not ported

papers.title: Deterministic Integer 3SUM in O(n^1.999017) Time via a Sharper Binomial-Tail Analysis
papers.learning: Keeping the binomial tail in a preprocessing analysis gives a smaller 3SUM exponent within an inherited thin-matrix/Exact-Triangle framework.
assumptions: Polynomially bounded integers and logarithmic word size
Three distinct input indices, even when values coincide
Include preprocessing, prime selection, query and witness costs
papers.reported_evidence: Exact rational interval certificates reported; improved runtime not Lean-formalized or locally implemented

papers.title: A Verified Constructive Reduction of the Cook-Levin Theorem in Lean 4: Bridging the Gap Between Complexity Theory and Formal SAT Encodings
papers.learning: A concrete machine-to-CNF reduction needs injective variable indexing and encoding soundness. A high-level theorem alone does not certify an emitted solver instance.
assumptions: Check indexing domains, boundary times, initialization, transitions and acceptance
Record auxiliary-variable growth
The claimed complete formalization needs a statement and axiom audit
papers.reported_evidence: Lean snippets and claimed formalization in paper; complete source build not independently reproduced

papers.title: Generalized Bawo: A Finite-State Model and an EXPTIME Upper Bound
papers.learning: A lap cap guarantees finite moves; an explicit state bound and WIN/LOSS/DRAW attractor give an EXPTIME upper bound for the defined game model.
assumptions: Binary cap encoding and successor-generation cost
Termination guards are part of semantics
An upper bound is not hardness and does not classify different real-world rules
papers.reported_evidence: Written finite-state upper bound; no formal or hardness result claimed
